sentences.en: I had taken a loathing to my gentleman at first sight.
sentences.zh: 我第一眼就对那位绅士产生了厌恶之情。

sentences.en: Sami developed loathing for his family.
sentences.zh: 萨米对他的家人产生了厌恶感。

sentences.en: Tom and Mary are loath to share any details of their private life.
sentences.zh: 汤姆和玛丽不愿意分享他们私生活的任何细节。

senses.zh: 勉强的；不情愿的（等于 loth）
